display_name: 联合自监督源 IQ 表征配对诊断
description: 只在此前探索过且不属于候选拟合 ID 的 672 条源 IQ，比较固定自监督编码器和同初始化随机编码器，在同 RX 和场景内匹配 clean、受损、DURA 与候选恢复视图；不读取身份标签。

data.representation: source paired clean and simulated received IQ; frozen DURA, trained G and training-only auxiliary encoder

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only record matching and collapse diagnostic; neither TX identification nor ground performance

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only DURA and fixed final epoch-5 joint-IQ-SSL correction and auxiliary encoder; random encoder reconstructed using its initialization seed
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura source provenance and SSL source summary/checkpoint fields; candidate fit IDs disjoint from 672 source pilot IDs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed F-free source-only DURA and auxiliary SSL model; target ancestry forbidden
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5, no metric-based candidate or target selection

expected_artifacts: result.json: source-only same-record matching and embedding statistics

metric_names: same-record cosine margin vs other source records within RX/scene

rows.method: Frozen trained versus initially random source IQ encoder, paired clean-to-view matching within public RX and scene
rows.purpose: Diagnose whether unlabeled source representation preserves record-level information, not device identity
rows.seed_notes: Auxiliary encoder original initialization seed 2026110615; frozen candidate and source pilot; no training or target access.
expected_artifacts: result.json: source-only same-record matching and embedding statistics

notes: Do not read F, TX labels, V, target IQ or target truth; no model updates.
Record matching may exploit payload or packet details and cannot be called TX identification accuracy.
The 672-record source pilot was previously explored and original DURA may have seen this domain; it is not an independent blind benchmark.
This diagnostic does not modify the already frozen candidate or its ongoing seven-view test.
